## Figma Design (Dark Mode): Buttons & States — Components

**Figma frame:** _Buttons & States — Components_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (tokens and theme).

### Context

Button system (primary/secondary/ghost) with hover/active/disabled/loading states matching the landing page style.

### What to design (in Figma)

- Primary, secondary, and ghost button variants.
- Default, hover, focus, active, disabled, and loading states.
- Icon, text, and icon-plus-text configurations with clear sizing and spacing rules.

### Deliverables

- Published button component set with variants, properties, and documented states.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Primary, secondary, and ghost variants are provided
- [ ] Hover, focus, active, disabled, and loading states are specified
- [ ] Focus and disabled treatments are accessible in dark mode
- [ ] Components use UI-17 tokens and are published for reuse
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Use reusable component variants and tokenized styles; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
